title: Why Use TypeScript in React Native?
overview: TypeScript improves React Native development by adding type safety, reducing errors, and making large applications easier to maintain.

example.title: Benefits
example.content:
✔ Safer code
✔ Better autocomplete
✔ Easier debugging
✔ Improved developer experience

title: Typing React Native Components
overview: React Native components can use TypeScript to define the types of props they receive, making components more predictable.

example.title: Component Props Example

title: Typing useState Hook
overview: useState can use TypeScript generics to define the type of state values stored inside a component.

title: Typing useRef and useEffect
overview: React hooks like useRef and useEffect can use TypeScript types to provide better safety when working with references and side effects.

title: Typing API Responses
overview: TypeScript interfaces and types are commonly used to define API response structures in React Native applications.

example.title: API Response Type

title: Typing Navigation
overview: TypeScript can define navigation routes and parameters, preventing invalid screen names and missing route data.

title: TypeScript with Redux in React Native
overview: Redux applications use TypeScript to define state structures, actions, reducers, and selectors for better type safety.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how TypeScript is used in React Native projects for components, hooks, APIs, navigation, and state management.
